bounds: One-sided exact bounds at the stated confidence: Clopper-Pearson for proportions, Poisson for incident rates. Windows of one run are correlated, so window-level bounds are optimistic; run-level bounds are the conservative reading.

all_features.method: 10 repetitions of 5-fold class-stratified cross-validation by run_id. In each fold the test fold is held out, about 15% of all runs are drawn from the remainder for validation and threshold selection, and the rest is used for training. Every run is tested exactly once per repetition.

threshold_rules.primary: validation rule used for the served model (lowest tied threshold)
threshold_rules.margin: same validation rule, median of tied thresholds (comparison only)

all_features.method: Primary seed-321 run split; every run of the held-out encryption scenario is removed from training and validation and scored as unseen. Scenarios come from trace names: asymm, symm_AES_* and symm_Salsa20_*. The dataset does not identify ransomware families.

without_process_concentration.method: Primary seed-321 run split; every run of the held-out encryption scenario is removed from training and validation and scored as unseen. Scenarios come from trace names: asymm, symm_AES_* and symm_Salsa20_*. The dataset does not identify ransomware families.

explanation_quality.method: Served artifact on the seed-321 test split. Deletion test: the k features with the largest positive SHAP value are set to the median of training benign windows; the control sets k random features. A faithful explanation lowers the probability more than the control.

false_alarm_projection.assumption: one host scored on consecutive 5-second windows for 24 hours; prevalences are illustrative shares of ransomware windows
